dataset_story: BEACON is a multimodal dataset of raw human gameplay telemetry streams designed to capture high-resolution behavioral fingerprints and inter-event timing (IET) rhythms. It provides the timing patterns needed to train deep sequential models.
aura_purpose: Evaluates mid-session user behavioral shifts and detects account takeover or automated replay/agent attacks using high-frequency client-side timings.

overview.name: BEACON
overview.title: BEACON: A Multimodal Dataset for Learning Behavioral Fingerprints

citation.text: Singh, I., et al. (2026). BEACON: A Multimodal Dataset for Learning Behavioral Fingerprints from Gameplay Data. arXiv:2605.10867.
